value.rationale: The minimum-gap pair deck is a natural sparse-sequencing observation. Weight two is the first level whose observations depend jointly on two marked positions; its exact two-parameter distinguishability capacity and sharp \(n=3s-1\) onset provide reusable finite-length benchmarks for sparse reconstruction codes, without a paper-sized downstream theorem requirement.
